title: F46 · through_the_wall · She Can Hear Them
lines: She is supposed to be asleep.
She cannot hear the words. She can hear the shape.
Money. His family. Her family. The same fight as last month.
Pari got out of bed. She did not go to them.
She went to the shelf, took down the picture, and carried it to their door.
Dadi says these two are one person, she said. Are you two one person?
"Dadi says these two are one person," she said. "Are you two one person?"
Then all three of them sat on the kitchen floor at midnight, eating biscuits, and the bill waited till morning.
Disagree. But remember who is listening through the wall. That is sadhana.
